t: You're on Conway Street, in Fitzrovia in the London Borough of Camden. It runs from the Euston Road in the north down to Maple Street in the south, and Fitzroy Square divides it in the middle. In the northern part, only Warren Street crosses it. The street takes its name from Isabella FitzRoy, Duchess of Grafton, a British peer and heiress who lived from 1668 to 1723. She later became the second Countess of Arlington in her own right.
